archive_policy.selection: Exact individual paths only; no directory tar/add recursion, inherited archive nesting, absolute arcnames, traversal, links, product executables, benchmark executables or full Rust/workspace/production-source copies.

archive_policy.consumer_archives: Current original burst, reviewed-cadence and qualified pre-C6 baseline consumer archives are separately owned publication artifacts; none is nested here.
archive_policy.original_records: Original mismatch, guard-stop and false-matcher records are retained, never rewritten or reclassified in place.

self_digest_policy.exception: Only the index self-entry has null bytes and SHA256. Its final size/digest are recorded outside by qualification-packaging-receipt.json; all other included files have exact byte counts and SHA256.
self_digest_policy.allowlist_self_entry: Allowlist lists its own arcname and the index arcname. Its bytes contain names only, so the index can bind the complete allowlist digest without circularity.
self_digest_policy.packaging_receipt_self_digest: Receipt does not embed its own digest. Its final bytes/digest are reported to the integration owner for the outer publication manifest.
